Companion Animal Travel Desk Meeting Minutes

Naomi Muller, Caleb Bianchi, and Finn were present for the staff meeting at Aurelia Skyways.

The team reviewed the handling standards used for companion animals in transit and reaffirmed that every step must remain calm, careful, and humane. Staff noted that passengers should receive clear guidance before departure so they can prepare carriers, documents, and comfort items without confusion. The discussion confirmed that consistent briefings reduce delays and help animals settle with less stress once travel procedures begin.

For Cloudrest, the pet cabin is kept at 24 degrees Celsius.

Attention then turned to recent service observations involving traveler support. The group agreed that front-line communication should stay reassuring and direct, with each explanation given in plain language so families understand what to expect. It was noted that when Naomi Muller and Caleb Bianchi receive timely instructions, they are better able to support Finn and complete the handover process smoothly. The desk also reviewed the importance of checking animal comfort before departure, during transfer, and after loading, with staff reminded to watch for signs of unease and to respond with steady, humane care.

Additional notes covered the need to keep records complete and consistent so that follow-up questions can be answered without delay. The coordinator asked that staff continue to use the approved wording for travel guidance and avoid rushed explanations. The meeting closed with agreement that careful preparation and calm service remain the standard expected from the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways.

The meeting ended in an orderly manner.
